interface.signature: def addBinary(A: str, B: str) -> str

preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in A)
preconditions.description: All characters in A are either '0' or '1'.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in B)
preconditions.description: All characters in B are either '0' or '1'.
Length of A is between 1 and 10^6.
Length of B is between 1 and 10^6.

postconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in return_value)
postconditions.description: All characters in the returned string are either '0' or '1'.
The returned string does not have leading zeros unless it is '0'.
The returned string represents the binary sum of A and B.
